basic_profile.bio: An avid fan of fantasy literature and deep lore discussions, I hail from Portland, Oregon. I work as a freelance writer and editor, specializing in genre fiction. My interests include exploring the intricate worlds of ASOIAF, debating character motivations, and occasionally diving into the technical aspects of hybrid vehicles. I'm a night owl, typically online from 8 PM to 2 AM PST, often found sipping a hot cup of Earl Grey tea. In a relationship with someone as geeky as I am, we often bond over our love for storytelling and world-building.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in English Literature and a lifelong passion for speculative fiction, I have immersed myself in worlds crafted by authors like George R.R. Martin and J.R.R. Tolkien. I honed my analytical skills through years of book discussions and online communities, coupled with my professional experience in writing and editing.
